# John Patrick Velasco

> Freelance automation specialist and technical virtual assistant, based in the Philippines, working with clients worldwide.

## Who he is

John Patrick Velasco (goes by Patrick; also known as JP Velasco or Patrick Velasco) is a freelance automation specialist and technical virtual assistant. He is a former full-stack developer who worked in government before moving into automation and technical VA work. He is based in the Philippines and works remotely with clients worldwide.

## Who he helps

Coaches, real estate agents, creators and UGC businesses, small business owners, and tech companies who need the technical side of their business set up and kept running.

## Services

- Business automation — connecting apps, forms and workflows with n8n, Zapier, Make and webhooks
- GoHighLevel (GHL) setup, sales funnels and landing pages
- Webinar automation, including AEvent
- CRM setup and cleanup in GoHighLevel or HubSpot
- Revenue operations — keeping pipelines, payments and reports in sync
- Email deliverability — SPF, DKIM, DMARC and Mailgun setup
- AI agents and assistants for lead replies and booking
- AI agents built on Claude, connected to business tools through MCP (Model Context Protocol) — so an agent can actually look up a contact, update a CRM or book a call, not just chat
- Payment notifications, for example posting to Discord when a client pays
- Simple web pages and fixes — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress, Hostinger

## How to work with him

- Start with a free 20-minute intro call to talk through what's needed.
- New clients usually start with a small, fixed-price trial project before anything bigger.
- Ongoing work is available as weekly hours (part-time or full-time) or a monthly retainer (reserved hours and priority each month).
- Available for weekly hours, a monthly retainer and one-off projects. Pricing is agreed after the intro call, based on scope.
